purpose.summary: This CICS online program returns a random customer number from a VSAM KSDS customer dataset. It reads low and high customer number bounds from a control Temporary Storage Queue (TSQ named GENACNTL), computes a random customer number within that range using EIBTASKN as a seed, then reads the nearest matching record from the VSAM file. The result is returned either via COMMAREA (if invoked by LINK) or via a CICS SEND TEXT screen.

notable_features: EXEC CICS commands throughout (ASSIGN, RECEIVE, READQ TS, WRITEQ TS, ENQ/DEQ, READ FILE, SEND TEXT, RETURN)
DFHCOMMAREA linkage section for inter-program communication
VSAM KSDS file access via EXEC CICS READ with GTEQ option
Temporary Storage Queue (TSQ) used as a control/seed store
FUNCTION RANDOM and FUNCTION INTEGER intrinsic functions
IBM GenApp sample application (GENACNTL TSQ, KSDSCUST file)
verdict.notes: This is part of the IBM CICS GenApp (General Insurance Application) sample, as evidenced by the 'CB12' product code, IBM copyright, TSQ name 'GENACNTL', and file name 'KSDSCUST'. The program handles both LINK (commarea) and transaction (RECEIVE) invocation modes. No EXEC SQL or COMP-3 usage. All lines fit within 72 columns confirming fixed format.
